name: Kevin Ford for State Senate
subject: Moving Forward With Gratitude and Purpose
body:
We did not win this election, but we built something real. | | |
---
| |
---
####
Dear friends, family, supporters, and partners,
#### **The people of District 24 have spoken, and I respect their decision.**
#### I want to congratulate Delegate Tiffany Alston on her victory. **Delegate Alston and I spoke following the election, and I congratulated her personally. We also mutually expressed the importance of working together to move our district forward.**
#### That matters to me.
#### Campaigns are competitive by nature, but public service requires humility, respect, and a willingness to keep the needs of the community above personal ambition. **District 24 deserves leaders who can compete, shake hands, and then find ways to work together for the people we all serve.**
#### _I also want to say thank you._
#### _Thank you to my family, who stood with me through this journey. Thank you to our volunteers, donors, supporters, advisors, and prayer warriors. Thank you to every person who opened a door, made a call, hosted a conversation, shared a post, gave a contribution, offered encouragement, or simply believed that our community deserved a serious conversation about its future._
#### _And I want to especially thank the more than 7,500 people who believed in me enough to cast their vote for me. I do not take that trust lightly. Your support is humbling, and it strengthens my commitment to continue serving, building, and fighting for the future our community deserves._
#### **We did not win this election.**
#### **But we built something real.**
#### We knocked on doors. We had honest conversations. We brought new people into the process. We connected families, young leaders, elders, business owners, faith leaders, and residents who still believe Prince George’s County has more to become.
#### That matters.
#### **This campaign was never just about a title. It was about service.** It was about families. It was about leadership. It was about whether we could imagine a stronger future and organize ourselves to pursue it.
#### And my answer is still yes.
#### Over the course of this campaign, I learned something that will stay with me: too much of our civic engagement begins right before an election. It should not be that way.
#### Leadership should not only show up during campaign season.
#### Community should not only matter every four years.
#### Young people should not have to wait until they are running for office to learn how government works.
#### Families should not feel disconnected from the decisions that shape their daily lives.
#### And Prince George’s County should not have to choose between accepting things as they are and hoping someone else comes to fix them.
#### We can build.
#### So I want to make a promise.
#### **This campaign is not simply ending. It is evolving.**
#### In the months ahead, I will be working to build something Prince George’s County deserves: a platform where future leaders are developed, where voters are educated, where families are strengthened, where young people discover public service, and where residents, businesses, faith leaders, educators, and community leaders can come together to solve problems.
#### **I am not asking you to stay connected because I have another campaign.**
#### **I am asking you to stay connected because there is still work to do.**
#### There are still leaders to develop.
#### There are still families to serve.
#### There are still communities to organize.
#### There is still a future worth building.
#### I did not enter this race because I wanted a title. I entered because I believe Prince George’s County has unlimited potential. That belief has not changed.
#### **I move forward with gratitude for everyone who supported me, humility about the outcome, respect for the voters, and a renewed commitment to public service.**
#### **Elections choose officeholders.**
#### **Communities build history.**
#### **And I still believe our best history is ahead of us.**
#### With gratitude and resolve,
#### **Kevin Ford, Jr.

Derek,
I'm writing to ask you to [**chip in $7 to the DNC today**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-july-2026-gfr?refcode=em_20260706_7894_fr&amount=7&refcode2=7894_22930333_qBFFXT&akid=7894%2E22930333%2EqBFFXT) — but first, I want to explain why your support in this specific moment is so critical.
The truth is that we have a real shot at winning back control of the Senate this November. That would mean electing a majority that can really put a check on the Trump administration and stick up for the interests of working Americans, not billionaires.
But I want to be honest with you: That kind of victory is _only_ possible with all hands on deck. Because, right now, Donald Trump’s megadonors have given the GOP a massive cash advantage (hundreds of millions of dollars, in fact). But 99% of the DNC’s donations come from a much, much mightier grassroots team made up of thousands of Americans giving $5 or $50 at a time.
Every contribution to the DNC allows them to register more voters, knock more doors, invest more in state parties, and distribute funds and resources to the races that need them most.
Derek, we just can’t let the DNC fall short of their end-of-month fundraising goal. Right now, they’re on track to do just that. President Donald Trump has spent years attacking vote-by-mail. Now his administration is taking the next step.
This week, the U.S. Postal Service confirmed that it is considering a plan that would force states to hand over lists of mail voters — or risk having ballots withheld altogether.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
For more than 25 years, Oregonians have trusted vote-by-mail because it works. It's secure. It's convenient. And it has become part of who we are as a state.
No president should be able to threaten that system with the stroke of a pen.
That’s why I’m marshalling a major grassroots response to this outrageous federal overreach before it’s too late. If you believe Oregonians — not Washington politicians — should decide how Oregon elections are run, add your name today and tell Donald Trump to keep his hands off our elections. >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
SIGN THE PETITION [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
The Constitution is clear: states and Congress set the rules for elections—not the President.
That's why Oregon is fighting back in court. That's why I'm speaking out. And that's why we need thousands of Oregonians standing together to send an unmistakable message: Hands off our vote-by-mail system.
If enough of us raise our voices now, we can show that Oregonians won't be intimidated into surrendering the voting system we've spent decades building. So please, add your name today and let’s take a stand for our democracy — before it’s too late. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]

wages.

body:
The federal guardrails are gone. It's time for the states to step in
| | | | |
---

[Go here for more actions](https://default.salsalabs.org/T92e5a2be-efec-4f31-96b8-d23380cb4649/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9))_ **[If Washington Won’t Defend the Constitution, the States Must Join Together to Do it](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te1c4bda2-a9eb-4570-900b-bc398ad5d9a6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Trump is shredding the Constitution, Congressional Republicans are cheering him on, and the Supreme Court isn’t doing a damn thing to stop him. **[If Washington Won’t Defend the Constitution, the States Must Join Together to Do it](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf839e485-82c2-4ce2-97f1-bf40b3630a5b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Too many Americans are still acting as if this is just politics as usual. It’s not. And with federal guardrails all but gone, states must step in. Governors, state attorneys general, and other key officials who still believe in the Constitution should form a Constitutional defense pact: a coordinated, lawful effort to protect elections, civil liberties, public servants, and the rule of law from presidential abuse of power. That means coordinating lawsuits. Working together against attacks that cross state lines. And if another state requests help protecting elections, public safety, or constitutional rights from actual attacks, other states should provide lawful mutual aid: legal teams, cybersecurity support, emergency personnel, election protection resources, and, where necessary to prevent violence, National Guard or state emergency support. This is not about partisanship. It is about defending the Constitution. And if red states want to join in, great. But if they can’t even take the simple step of pledging to defend the Constitution, that itself will speak volumes. **[Sign: If Washington Won’t Defend the Constitution, the States Must Join Together to Do it](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5e647fcd-0628-49e1-8e86-8b9086195a8a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**

And if another state requests help protecting elections, public safety, or constitutional rights from actual attacks, other states should provide lawful mutual aid: legal teams, cybersecurity support, emergency personnel, election protection resources, and, where necessary to prevent violence, National Guard or state emergency support. This is not about partisanship. It is about defending the Constitution. And if red states want to join in, great. But if they can’t even take the simple step of pledging to defend the Constitution, that itself will speak volumes. | | | | | LeftAction . | Washington, District of Columbia . | info@leftaction.com Follow Us | | Having trouble viewing this email? | | or

Top of mind for us is canvassing and phone banking: these are the two _most effective_ ways to get Aly in front of more Vermonters before the primary...which is in 36 days! Making calls is easy with our auto-dialing system and canvassing gets you out in our beautiful summer weather. We want (and need) to be covering as many doors and phones as we can in these last weeks. Join us!

body:
Hi Everyone,

Hope you all had a wonderful Fourth of July celebrating our nation's 250th Birthday! Marni spent it throughout the district celebrating with our incredible community and we are so glad to announce that the California Democratic Party is hosting **days of action** every weekend to get out the vote - **starting this weekend, July 11th and 12th**!

Come out and and walk with Marni as we get out to our neighbors and start the turn out game to take the fight to Trump! Here's event details below:

**_Kick-Off CADEM Canvasses_**
**Saturday, July 11th, 9 AM - Murrietta, CA -[Sign Up Here](https://www.mobilize.us/mobilize/event/966122/)**
**Sunday, July 12th, 10:30 AM - Vista, CA -[Sign Up here](https://www.mobilize.us/mobilize/event/965832/)**

And also, just a reminder that our **Volunteer Appreciation Lunch is this Sunday, July 12th at 12****PM -** come join Marni for some amazing BBQ right here in Vista at Bub Williamson Park!

**[Sign Up Here so we have enough for everyone - and more!](https://forms.gle/h7VNjjmHVugPniaV7)**

Want to join us for another fun event? Marni and the team will be marching in **San Diego Pride** and we'd love for you to join us! It's taking place on **July 18th at 10 AM**! Come on out for a great time and show your support for our LGBTQ+ community!

**[RSVP for Pride Parade Here!](https://forms.gle/UM5avaEARY1RBkQj6)**

Thank you for everything and excited to see you all soon!

Best Regards,
Quinton with Team Marni

First it was the Nazi tattoo.
Then the _New York Times_ reports of abusive behavior toward previous girlfriends.
Now, a new Graham Platner scandal is in the offing -- and it doesn't involve his embellished claims about his oyster hobby.
As _The Robinson Report_ [conveyed](https://substack.com/redirect/2ed8ec5c-d085-4862-a56c-cd62e08e9b27?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) last week, a well-placed news item indicated that women with previous romantic involvement with Platner had connected with Cheyenne Hunt, an attorney and progressive social media influencer.
Hunt entering the chat is significant because she previously endorsed Platner, then un-endorsed him, and Hunt last made national news by helping the alleged victims of U.S. Rep. Eric Swalwell (D-Calif.) come forward, effectively ending Swalwell's campaign for governor of the Golden State.
If you're reading the tea leaves, that means more women are coming forward.
Subscribe for the latest New England political news (it's free, usually)
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..9aPXyf4gIkxCisVJDtT0TgaouFkXRH9Vi2GrM5JeoU0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=205647816)
That is, more women than were reported in June by the _New York Times_.
The Time's story was based largely on allegations from Lyndsey Fifield, who dated Platner roughly from 2013 to 2015. Because Fifield was a Republican staffer living in Washington, D.C., Maine Democrats -- including top officials and Democratic voters -- brushed aside her allegations of abusive behavior.
As bizarre as it seems, the Democrat Rules for Sex Scandals seem to preclude any Republicans from leveling credible allegations (unless they're leveled against another Republican, of course).
The approaching scandal appears to be landing differently. Which means a few things: a major media outlet (or perhaps multiple major outlets) has ahold of serious allegations coming from women who can't be brushed off as political smears. Or maybe it's dudes. Who knows with Platner, the guy has _a lot_ of Reddit posts about gay sex acts.
Whatever the brewing scandal is, Platner's campaign seems to be handling it much differently than the Nazi tattoo and the _Times_ story. In both of those cases, Platner plowed forward with live events, and his core supporters seemed to rally to his side with even more vigor. Platner even went to Capitol Hill in the wake of the _Times_ report to tell Democratic senators face-to-face that no more damaging information would be coming out on him.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..9aPXyf4gIkxCisVJDtT0TgaouFkXRH9Vi2GrM5JeoU0?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=205647816)
Sources tell _The Robinson Report_ that Platner exited early from the 4th of July parade in Eastport and then no-showed the Machias parade in the evening. Monday morning, Platner's campaign canceled multiple live events, including town halls in Gorham and Augusta.
Tellingly, Platner's number one social media fanboy, a man who just last week said that any Democrat who opposed Platner should be put up against a wall and shot, put his X account into "Private" mode -- a sure sign that someone has entered crisis communications mode.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/151bdb60-8c67-4276-b65b-89e0e2cc14b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Socialist social media is filled with speculation that Platner will be dropping out ahead of the July 13th deadline for a candidate to voluntarily terminate their candidacy.
Adding to the speculation: This weekend and this morning, pollsters were in the field testing the favorability of multiple Maine Democrats, an indication that someone with significant cash to burn is searching for the best potential replacement for Platner.

The moral of the story: It appears that Republican U.S. Sen. Susan Collins has the Mandate of Heaven, for she's surely blessed with the worst possible opponents.
The full story will break this evening. Stay tuned to _The Robinson Report_ for updates and make sure to watch [Maine Wire TV](https://substack.com/redirect/1c2ae647-1c6c-4fca-a072-7232afc8d374?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as we cover it live.

Donald Trump forgets: The USPS delivers the mail. It does not run elections. It serves every address in the country, regardless of party, race, income, geography, disability, age, or citizenship status. Its mandate is to provide universal service to the public, not carry out Trump’s voter suppression agenda .
Team, we have fought attacks on vote by mail before, and when the public speaks up and fights back, we’ve won. The USPS is required to hear public comments on this plan before they can implement it. It’s time to fight back and win — again .
Demand USPS reject this unlawful order, protect universal service, and refuse to let the mail become a weapon against eligible voters >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/demand-usps-reject-trumps-illegal-order/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Folks: Donald Trump is trying to turn the United States Postal Service into a federal checkpoint for mail-in ballots — and the USPS is getting ready to implement the illegal order in less than 30 days.
If this rule moves forward and is made final, millions of registered voters would not even receive their ballots to vote in federal elections , including for Congress or for President.
Let’s be crystal clear here: We’re not even talking about voters mailing their ballots back. We’re talking about the post office being told to not even send certain people their ballots to vote in the first place.
Tell USPS: Ignore this illegal order and deliver our ballots whether we are on Trump's list or not >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/demand-usps-reject-trumps-illegal-order/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
START WRITING NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/demand-usps-reject-trumps-illegal-order/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
The proposed rule is based on Trump’s voter suppression executive order that attacks vote by mail . It would require state election officials to send USPS a list of voters based in part on Department of Homeland Security-created citizenship databases that have repeatedly been shown to be inaccurate and flawed .
Trump is trying to illegally declare the post office a federal election administrator to decide whether to mail certain eligible voters their ballots under the false flag of election security.
Voting by mail is safe, secure, convenient , and for many people, it is the only accessible way to cast a ballot. Seniors, voters with disabilities, rural voters, Indigenous communities, military families, students, caregivers, and working people all rely on the mail to exercise their right to vote.
Send your letter. Fight back. Stop Trump from disenfranchising millions of eligible voters. >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/demand-usps-reject-trumps-illegal-order/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

body:
One hour until kickoff. And I've got a goal of my own to score before midnight.
| | | | | [](https://kseax8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001m4GRoSfw02xy5Oxtwz00VATqnZp_y0DShCvDOjVNB4HQyE5pHeQgVWLlEsbPzaR3fYZDdxz-pdhW_9KUeEGidwewwWxgod6SLB4SywCTx1853-7gXtdrLw-jt6hnvkdC-JuUIeigseL1mNrft7JRDOJcYSecOmIsSoPxEg2aDwHF00mg6Scjm0WwD4OrO7ztNzxIOpcLUJMK0cy1NLz-fw==&c=4H0khYqDkh89U8AOTUHLZiRvcCZlNFnr4Spl1bbzpze204El8gyHCg==&ch=U4jKiCMCwKMAITZbARiBYPYJj8JnTk_KtqB5FJ1gdDFocw2PdBNlTg==)
---
Peter,
I'll admit: I have never been much of a soccer fan... until now, that is!
Something about watching these young men represent our country on the world's biggest stage has gotten into my blood. And tonight -- one hour from now -- the US Men's National Team takes on Belgium in a game that could put us through to the next round of the World Cup.
But here's what moves me most about this team. Look at them. Really look at them:
---
| [](https://kseax8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001m4GRoSfw02xy5Oxtwz00VATqnZp_y0DShCvDOjVNB4HQyE5pHeQgVWLlEsbPzaR3fYZDdxz-pdhW_9KUeEGidwewwWxgod6SLB4SywCTx1853-7gXtdrLw-jt6hnvkdC-JuUIeigseL1mNrft7JRDOJcYSecOmIsSoPxEg2aDwHF00mg6Scjm0WwD4OrO7ztNzxIOpcLUJNJjQD6mlXLhw==&c=4H0khYqDkh89U8AOTUHLZiRvcCZlNFnr4Spl1bbzpze204El8gyHCg==&ch=U4jKiCMCwKMAITZbARiBYPYJj8JnTk_KtqB5FJ1gdDFocw2PdBNlTg==)
---
They are America. White, Black, brown. Rich kids and working-class kids. Sons of immigrants and sons of families who've been here for generations. Different backgrounds, different stories, different paths that all led to the same jersey.
And tonight they are one. Playing for one flag. Fighting for one goal. (No pun intended, I swear.)
That's the America I believe in. That's the America worth fighting for. Not the divided, fearful, us-versus-them America that MAGA is trying to sell us -- but this one. The one on that field tonight where it doesn't matter where you came from, only what you're willing to give.
Now, I'll say this: It rubbed me the wrong way that Trump stuck his nose in the middle of the World Cup today. But I'll be damned if I'm going to let him take away my pride in this team and what they've set out to accomplish.
And honestly, this campaign reminds me a lot of the campaign we're building.
Our campaign is its own team. Farmers and teachers. Voters from all different backgrounds. Women who showed up to vote in historic numbers. Young people who've never knocked a door before in their lives. Tens of thousands donors from all across this country who looked at a fourth-generation farmer from Waterproof, Louisiana and said -- yeah, that's our guy.
Different backgrounds. Different stories. One goal. Just like our boys on the field tonight.
Luckily, today also happens to be my birthday, which means a night off the campaign trail for me. I'm going to be with my family, feet up, watching our boys in red, white, and blue give Belgium everything they've got.
But before I do that, I have one small ask: [We've got a fundraising goal of $10,000 before midnight. Will you help us hit the goal tonight by chipping in $25, $10, or even $5 to keep our team in the fight? ⚽ Just like the USMNT, we need every member of our team showing up tonight!](https://kseax8hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001m4GRoSfw02xy5Oxtwz00VATqnZp_y0DShCvDOjVNB4HQyE5pHeQgVWLlEsbPzaR3GKucf8WdHvdVZUrp3s9SUHt6EcoaPiir21KlJjbfkcnx32JR4RrZmFsuLpFQrwvCeSGERIw328saYBM2T3W26U9qva_jCTHVgKyypVHwUMBlzfFXy02PH8CP2xc0q1AmqL33YhX2U1XnXzVzOPe_cQJXYH8RayQM&c=4H0khYqDkh89U8AOTUHLZiRvcCZlNFnr4Spl1bbzpze204El8gyHCg==&ch=U4jKiCMCwKMAITZbARiBYPYJj8JnTk_KtqB5FJ1gdDFocw2PdBNlTg==)

| [](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=d47febb7effe47bd86f5d515947cdeb9&_e=INDpJU0Vk1qotcOLJpk4EgR6vme06fpSx7MvBD73ovdAICoP8Y6nuoTE56jiCfqMNP5b71N3-OpElSXZinV4yJkkw5elr80RKhKZRAd6N8o5sr20goJX7FFyxOwM_cnZN8f5_C4_xqDFxk5k89vKoNfp9yFhxy0kIe-5JwGUs4MhlDH-ofp5SFdqu0Qg66wUye59L4VMVm5FazxRX1w1zqF1DhWzt0Yr45iCPshn-dT-zhLnD_MtPIQRiuBl30fYK4TcpncQA1R4XRGCKJrW-sRZsBxc9Vl2kWH7e4tXOi81yuxp8lOKO524naR0XphqkoV92xn4W74-nckN1o2ip_ZbFCMv3-w1xC4zRfivKnT4ZA4_MhhaunSVD_-X5qQ6Fl6wEpRDThUrxEpAjuizZDlgsyYD3C10b4V0nXEU4-y7Su8sU4shHmci-1MMA_mc)

Peter,

I love this country.

I believe in hard work, personal responsibility, and the idea that if you put in the effort, you can build a good life for your family.

I believe in public safety, secure borders, and a government that trusts people to make their own decisions. That is the America I grew up believing in and are the same values I was raised on here in the Hudson Valley.

****Today and especially in the 250th year of our nation’s founding, I am proud to be an American!** **

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=d47febb7effe47bd86f5d515947cdeb9&_e=INDpJU0Vk1qotcOLJpk4EgR6vme06fpSx7MvBD73ovdAICoP8Y6nuoTE56jiCfqMNP5b71N3-OpElSXZinV4yJkkw5elr80RKhKZRAd6N8o5sr20goJX7FFyxOwM_cnZN8f5_C4_xqDFxk5k89vKoNfp9yFhxy0kIe-5JwGUs4MhlDH-ofp5SFdqu0Qg66wUye59L4VMVm5FazxRX1w1zqF1DhWzt0Yr45iCPshn-dT-zhLnD_MtPIQRiuBl30fYK4TcpncQA1R4XRGCKJrW-r-R0pXDousIol8UPDhM6Q74r_JP6ILDwT4kUc7PpmQ59p8ufxagC2XmF8xmvh8FJl9wX1xEdZ5DButQie8PMMRi2LkKZPXbKw6-fi_LO6q4NibBDhlXEXRxun5DCkTm9pawto9uI5yYNZoGd_Z1JAtwtYePrFXFMuNkPBE-6wpP)
Recently, New York Democrats showed a very different vision. Socialist candidates swept Democrat primaries across our state, and their platform speaks for itself: abolish the police, abolish prisons, abolish ICE, and nationalize entire industries like energy and healthcare. Their movement's own leaders have said it plainly. They are not trying to reform the Democrat Party. They are trying to take it over.

**I will be honest with you. None of that sits right with me.**

But I am not running because I want to be part of the noise. Nor am I running to be a lightning rod or to add to the division already tearing this country apart. I am running because I believe NY-18 deserves a representative who is actually here to serve, not to perform.

I believe most people, no matter how they vote, just want a government that puts them first, an economy that allows them to get ahead, and a community where their kids can build a good life.

That is not a radical idea. It should be common sense.

subject: Our roots run deeper than any court decision
body:
We're building something bigger than this moment — a movement for citizenship. | | | Peter, In just the last few weeks, the Supreme Court has issued a wave of decisions that will shape the lives of millions of working families across the country. Late last month, the Supreme Court cleared the way for the Trump Administration to strip Temporary Protected Status from hundreds of thousands of people from Haiti and Syria. It upheld a policy that allows border agents to turn asylum seekers away before they can even make their case. Thankfully, one recent ruling was a victory for our movement when the Court upheld the constitutional right to birthright citizenship — a fundamental guarantee that this administration tried to erase with the stroke of a pen.1 **[Courts will sometimes protect us and sometimes fail us. But no court decision — no ruling, no executive order — gets to define who we are or where we belong. Home is here. Will you chip in $10 today to power the movement for citizenship?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAe_ANaZPpDQuekprkyb6preo-SPVaonq8ZGZKS0mnIHz_-vBRqTzkeOvVDS4g2VHi7gyB6E8DKvGt2o_zD0gLqP9n3ofLugiIwu6T8JPaLhM3rgbDnRX8rtsF9qS66lHhwbPmoXMRCmyVfR4y46RBZsnKe_9kFmf_-cWt6pCObHYX5X0VcYPmsx8VZwQgTDnzpe7D5c5B69dV7CsiMbujPJo3EmPNcygbmVj_lbcEvn53RPTF8BZ8WRRNXNRNCB3PAbnDwN7D8I7Spb8X0uSnqSoAQSaj_0RTKLM97eq1I_QDuvF8XEE32RaYD1qzslkzOjbcC9ER2Sa-rWzLHhCDGr7IgOIRoAzXJWmocPMqqJcs6qIRzpWEl1ZL4lEXaqV66mF5Xvpx7BuYorhVuclpsyg/4s3/PUsSWAV8Tua8tNo1Ns8wsA/h0/h001.6GACTCXZjgfU_tdzMuhRT2oA-kFBMkUkwAesHacrUp8)** Whether it's TPS holders, DACA recipients, asylum seekers, or families whose citizenship itself was called into question — these court decisions are not isolated. A recent NPR investigation documented how they are part of a coordinated strategy to strip away the legal protections immigrant families rely on, backed by historic new funding for 2029.1 The human cost is devastating. More than 100,000 U.S. citizen children have had a parent detained under this administration.2 More than 340 DACA recipients have been detained, and over 90 deported under this administration. These numbers only reflect the cases we know about. Our nation thrives on the labor, care, and contributions of our immigrant neighbors, coworkers, and loved ones. And this agenda doesn’t stop with immigrants - the same forces funding raids are the ones deciding working people everywhere are disposable. That’s why we organize. clean_body: We're building something bigger than this moment — a movement for citizenship. | | | Peter, In just the last few weeks, the Supreme Court has issued a wave of decisions that will shape the lives of millions of working families across the country. Late last month, the Supreme Court cleared the way for the Trump Administration to strip Temporary Protected Status from hundreds of thousands of people from Haiti and Syria. It upheld a policy that allows border agents to turn asylum seekers away before they can even make their case. Thankfully, one recent ruling was a victory for our movement when the Court upheld the constitutional right to birthright citizenship — a fundamental guarantee that this administration tried to erase with the stroke of a pen.1 Whether it's TPS holders, DACA recipients, asylum seekers, or families whose citizenship itself was called into question — these court decisions are not isolated. A recent NPR investigation documented how they are part of a coordinated strategy to strip away the legal protections immigrant families rely on, backed by historic new funding for 2029.1 The human cost is devastating. More than 100,000 U.S. citizen children have had a parent detained under this administration.2 More than 340 DACA recipients have been detained, and over 90 deported under this administration. These numbers only reflect the cases we know about. Our nation thrives on the labor, care, and contributions of our immigrant neighbors, coworkers, and loved ones. And this agenda doesn’t stop with immigrants - the same forces funding raids are the ones deciding working people everywhere are disposable. That’s why we organize. We are calling on Congress to take action and finally deliver a clear pathway to citizenship. Graham Platner, the ex-Marine with a Totenkopf tattoo and an oyster hobby whose Icarus-like rise in American politics saw him endorsed by progressive icons such as U.S. Sens. Bernie Sanders (I-Vt.) and Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.), is facing new allegations of sexual misconduct.
According to [Politico](https://substack.com/redirect/7a266e39-5bf0-4cf7-913f-7531c938ac37?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a Maine woman has accused Platner of drunkenly breaking into her house and sexually assaulting her.
[Share The Robinson Report](https://substack..mIAsbHRpBHgMZbAWbMHx01IUjOfLx4fou0gPd40O1KY?)
From Politico:
> **A woman who dated Maine U.S. Senate candidate Graham Platner says he forced her to have sex with him nearly five years ago despite her repeated objections, an allegation Platner denies.**
> **The woman, a 41-year-old Maine resident named Jenny Racicot, detailed the alleged incident to POLITICO in three interviews over the past two weeks. POLITICO also spoke with a man Racicot dated and confided in the years after the alleged incident, and reviewed documents, including emails between Racicot and her therapist and messages between Racicot and an acquaintance whom she warned against getting involved with Platner years before he ran for office.**
> **...**
> **" I remember him grabbing my pelvis and being really forceful of me," she said. "I remember the specific moment where I thought to myself, like, 'This is no longer my choice.'"**
> **Platner denied the allegations.**
According to the story, Racicot connected with Platner on a dating app and had consensual sex with him one evening. Then, the following evening, he showed up to her house uninvited -- letting himself into her unlocked home.
Per Politico:
> **Platner came up the stairs, Racicot said, to where she was on a couch. He got on top of her and kept grabbing her, she said, while she repeatedly told him to stop and that she wasn 't interested. Racicot said she smelled alcohol on his breath and believed he was "almost blackout drunk" because Platner ignored her protests and continued to grab her after knocking over an antique sewing kit, spilling small needles everywhere.**
> **...**
> **Racicot said she tried to separate herself from Platner by telling him she couldn 't be in that room anymore, after which he followed her to her bedroom and had sex with her against her will. She said he also ejaculated inside of her despite her telling him not to, as she was not using birth control at the time.**
> **She went to clean herself up, she said, and when she returned, Platner had fallen asleep. She contemplated waking him up to kick him out, but worried he could hurt someone driving in the state he was in.**
> **The following morning, she said, Platner tried to put his arm around her and she pushed him away. She said she asked him whether he remembered what had happened the previous night; according to Racicot, Platner said he didn 't remember. Racicot said she told him to leave and never contact her again.**
Platner secured the Maine Democratic Party's nomination on June 9, crushing Gov. Janet Mills 71.9 percent to 19.3 percent. In subsequent weeks, betting websites and several polls pegged him as the favorite to unseat incumbent Republican U.S. Sen. Susan Collins.

Word of the impending story spread last week among Maine politicos, with scant details but serious tones and whispers of gross sexual assault. On Independence Day, multiple sources said Platner left the Eastport parade early and was a no-show at the Machias parade that evening.
Throughout Monday, Platner's campaign cancelled multiple town hall events and word slowly spread through social media that some form of scandal was looming over his candidacy.
This is not the first time Platner has faced allegations of sexual misconduct.
The most detailed accounting, before Monday, emerged in a June 4, 2026, New York Times investigation, which interviewed multiple women who dated Platner over the years. While some described him as charming and caring, others recounted volatile, "toxic" relationships marked by heavy drinking, infidelity, emotional volatility, and, in at least one case, physical aggression.
Lyndsey Fifield, who dated Platner roughly from 2013 to 2015, provided the most specific claims. She alleged that he "regularly grabbed her by the shoulders--sometimes hard enough to leave marks." During one argument, she said he "twisted her arm behind her back, shoved her into a bedroom and held the door closed from the other side so she couldn't get out, telling her to remain there until she was 'calm.'" Fifield also described him yanking her out of a taxi by the wrist and using crude language, including referring to women in vulgar terms and making unsettling comments about hypothetical rape scenarios.
Platner, according to the New York Times story, often fantasized about raping a hypothetical burglar, though he was always clear that the anal rape would be performed "not in a gay way."
Despite Fifield's vivid and credible description of domestic violence, Platner's supporters, national Democrats, and Democrats in Maine brushed aside who claims as politically motivated because Fifield lives in Washington, D.C., and works as a Republican staffer.
Other women interviewed by the New York Times, though, echoed themes of unsettling conduct: demeaning remarks, emotional turbulence tied to Platner's admitted struggles with PTSD, depression, and alcohol, and a pattern of infidelity. These accounts align with broader reports of Platner sending sexually explicit texts to at least six women outside his purported marriage to Amy Gertner--messages his own wife reportedly flagged to campaign staff.
Compounding this are Platner's old Reddit posts (under the handle "P-Hustle," deleted before his run), where he downplayed sexual assault, suggesting victims "take some responsibility" by avoiding alcohol or compromising situations, and made other crude or dismissive comments about women and military reporting protocols.
Using a variation of the same username, Platner also used an account on a little known social media app called Kik, an app that law enforcement and child safety advocates have described as a "predator's paradise." The app has slim age verification features and has featured in several recent cases of child sex crimes just in Maine.
Platner has consistently denied physical abuse or assault, calling many claims "simply not true" and "politically motivated." He acknowledges being "far from the perfect boyfriend" during a difficult period of undiagnosed PTSD and heavy drinking but insists he has grown, sought accountability, and rebuilt his life.
At least some well-funded Democrat operators believe Platner is bound to drop out of the race -- which he would have to do voluntarily by July 13 for Democrats to legally select a new nominee.
Throughout the weekend and on Monday, Democrats were polling dozens of Maine Democrat names for favorability in a theoretical match-up against Collins, including actor Patrick Dempsey. The poll questions outright stated the possibility of Platner being replaced as the nominee.
The poll was among the first indications that Democratic insiders had begun preparing for an eventuality in which the damage to Platner's odds of winning became so severe that he would voluntarily withdraw from the race by the July 13th deadline. Unless Platner himself agrees to terminate his candidacy, Democrats have no mechanism from replacing him on the ballot.

This is
Mary Trump, and I was recently on MS NOW.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260706-split.pAVmzL&refcode=em20260706-61605&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=61605%2E1407376%2Eh4Tgsj ]Mary Trump on MS NOW.

In case you missed it, the compromised Department of Justice granted
Donald and his children total immunity from federal tax audits and
prosecution.

It’s another example of the abject corruption that is plaguing our country
to benefit the ultra-wealthy, like my uncle and his cronies. In fact, the
latest estimates say that Donald’s immediate family has made over $4
billion from his presidency:

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260706-split.pAVmzL&refcode=em20260706-61605&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=61605%2E1407376%2Eh4Tgsj ]Headline from The New Yorker: 'Trump's Profiteering Hits $4 Billion.'

So here’s where we are:

> We have a President, and a Republican Party, full of enablers who refuse
to uphold the Constitution.

>> We have a corrupt, illegitimate supermajority on the Supreme Court that
has given Donald almost total immunity for his actions, no matter how
criminal, and bent over backwards to grant him almost total power.

>>> On the other side, we have people like you and me who believe in the
promise of America and who refuse to stay silent when our country and its
citizens need us most.

That’s why I’m starting Transcend PAC, and that’s why you’re receiving
this email today.

Transcend PAC is the counter to a subservient Republican Congress,
Cabinet, and Supreme Court that continue to place one man above the law
while doing untold damage to the Constitutional order. Together, we can
fund the candidates and organizations that have the vision and fortitude
to restore accountability, protect our institutions, and transcend this
dark era in our country’s history.

includes you.

Mary

That’s why I’m starting Transcend PAC, and that’s why you’re receiving this email today. Transcend PAC is the counter to a subservient Republican Congress, Cabinet, and Supreme Court that continue to place one man above the law while doing untold damage to the Constitutional order. Together, we can fund the candidates and organizations that have the vision and fortitude to restore accountability, protect our institutions, and transcend this dark era in our country’s history. [ ]If you believe in this mission, please split a donation between Transcend PAC and Demand Justice PAC. The work of accountability doesn't happen on its own — it will take all of us joining together, and that includes you. [ ]Donate $5 ›› I’m grateful to have you with me in this fight, Mary

disclaimer_text: Paid for by State Democrats Committee (StateDemocrats
body:
I’m not asking you to choose between New Hampshire and the rest of the map. I’m telling you New Hampshire is the map.
#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106023?refcode=em20260706-10651&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10651%2E614464%2EIXD2Ml)
Folks, it’s James Carville.
I’ve worked Senate races in every corner of the country, and I know how to read a map. So hear me when I say this: **New Hampshire is keeping me up at night.**
I’m watching this year’s races closely, and money is pouring into Georgia, North Carolina, Ohio, Texas, Alaska, and Maine. That’s critical because those races are part of Democrats’ path to retaking the Senate.
But here’s what’s scaring the hell out of me: **If Chris Pappas loses New Hampshire, Democrats need to flip FIVE seats instead of four to take back the Senate. That math doesn’t work. Full stop.**
**[Before you read another word, chip in $5 or whatever you can to Chris Pappas and State Democrats Committee to make sure New Hampshire doesn’t become the reason Democrats lose the Senate.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106023?refcode=em20260706-10651&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10651%2E614464%2EIXD2Ml)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $5](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106024?refcode=em20260706-10651&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=5&t=3&akid=10651%2E614464%2EIXD2Ml) [Contribute $15](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106024?refcode=em20260706-10651&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=15&t=4&akid=10651%2E614464%2EIXD2Ml) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106024?refcode=em20260706-10651&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=5&akid=10651%2E614464%2EIXD2Ml) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106024?refcode=em20260706-10651&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=6&akid=10651%2E614464%2EIXD2Ml) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106024?refcode=em20260706-10651&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=7&akid=10651%2E614464%2EIXD2Ml) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106024?refcode=em20260706-10651&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=8&akid=10651%2E614464%2EIXD2Ml) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106023?refcode=em20260706-10651&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&akid=10651%2E614464%2EIXD2Ml)
---
Chris is up just one point. One. 45-44. **That is a tied race.** And while the whole country is staring at Georgia and North Carolina, New Hampshire is sitting there in a dead heat with nobody riding to the rescue.
John Sununu — yeah, _those Sununus_ — has the name, the money, and a Republican machine that knows exactly what’s at stake here. They don’t need to flip five seats. They just need to flip New Hampshire red and let the map do the rest.
And right now? **They’ve got a real shot at doing exactly that.**
Chris Pappas is the only guy who can win this seat. He’s won the toughest district in New Hampshire four damn times. He knows how to bring people together. But he cannot — _cannot_ — do this alone when every check is being written and every eyeball is looking somewhere else.
So here’s what I need from you:
**[Rush a contribution split between Chris Pappas and State Democrats Committee today. $10, $25, $5, whatever you can spare. Because if we let this seat slip away while everybody’s watching Georgia, we’re gonna wake up in November and wonder how the hell we let it happen.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106023?refcode=em20260706-10651&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=10651%2E614464%2EIXD2Ml)**
I’m not asking you to choose between New Hampshire and the rest of the map. I’m telling you New Hampshire _is_ the map. You hold this seat, and Democrats have a real path to the majority. You lose it, and it doesn’t matter what happens in North Carolina, Texas, Maine, or anywhere else.
Don’t let New Hampshire be the reason we come up one seat short.
**[Give what you can right now.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106023?refcode=em20260706-10651&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=11&akid=10651%2E614464%2EIXD2Ml)** Let’s win this damn thing and flip control of the Senate.
— James Carville

The Trump administration has pulled funding from the state of New York's Medicaid Fraud Control Unit because of the Unit's laughable underperformance. HHS sent the **[letter](https://substack.com/redirect/5ca2f11b-c7d2-438f-8e1c-b2b055388b56?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to New York Attorney General Letitia James and Medicaid Fraud Control Unit Director Amy Held, stating that the fraud task force was the lowest performing Unit when compared with other states.
New York receives $60 million from the federal government each year and maintains a staff of 270 employees for the sole purpose of preventing Medicaid fraud. Despite this, the Unit only successfully prosecuted "eight or nine criminal indictments while other similar-sized Units have secured hundreds."

A former consultant to the Pentagon was able to enter the airspace near one of the most secure sites in the world. Hidden there, he says, is a potential **$10 trillion tech breakthrough** that could define the next decade of Elon Musk's career.
**[Click here to learn about the stocks tied to Elon Musk's next big venture.](https://substack.com/redirect/476514ea-4570-410d-a95a-140151e7d7d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Click here!](https://substack.com/redirect/476514ea-4570-410d-a95a-140151e7d7d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
The letter further pointed out that those other Units oversee programs that "are half the size" of New York's. New York has one of the largest Medicaid systems in the country, costing over $100 billion per year for its coverage of 7 million people. The unit's negligence has put billions of taxpayer dollars at stake, as the state's unwillingness to investigate and prosecute fraud has opened the Medicaid system up to exploitation.
After an onsite review, HHS attributed much of the Unit's failures to their leadership. Unit managers intentionally stopped looking into "criminal fraud", "patient abuse", and "neglect." They claimed to be shifting their focus to "high-impact, complex fraud" and civil cases in defiance of regulations that required them to prosecute criminal fraud. The shift did not lead to an increase in prosecutions, but rather allowed them to become the lowest performing Unit from 2023 to 2025 by "a wide margin." 34% of the Unit's open cases were more than 3 years old, and 69% referrals had a 'Pending' status at the Unit for more than 2 years.
* * *
* * *
## The Capitalist is a reader-supported publication, we exist for you, because of you!
[Support What We Do](https://substack.com/redirect/6a478cac-4aa1-444e-8b31-fbff0899a981?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
In February and March of this year, a House committee began investigating Medicaid fraud in ten states, specifically to "ensure program integrity in states nationwide." New York Governor Kathy Hochul accused Congressional Republicans of targeting Democrat-run states like New York and California, but **[admitted](https://substack.com/redirect/c78412dd-2fdc-4f79-aaed-9c3b959838e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that there was waste, fraud, and abuse in the system. Jessica Gay, a Certified Fraud Examiner, **[testified](https://substack.com/redirect/6d903027-1892-48a0-b2fc-b177a55b8043?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** before the House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee. She noted that "If a state isn't monitoring [Medicaid programs] closely, they are likely missing a considerable area where fraud is committed."
Gay also referenced the **[$68 million](https://substack.com/redirect/00701d3d-e8e3-4e75-8606-7776787baa9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** adult day care Medicaid fraud scheme uncovered in 2024. Two individuals in Brooklyn engaged in a series of kick-backs and recruitment bribes that allowed them to defraud Medicaid, stealing millions from the system. New York's Medicaid Fraud Control Unit does not appear to be listed in the investigation or prosecution of this corruption. The lead agencies include the DOJ, HHS-OIG, EDNY, and NYPD. They also do not appear on any court documents. The state's own Fraud Control Unit didn't participate in the discovery or prosecution of one of the largest fraud schemes in New York's history.
* * *
* * *
### Support The Capitalist by getting the SubStack App
[Get the App](https://substack.com/redirect/ef30f9e2-9f53-4c9e-b592-a9de75cc89a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
The Trump administration is clearly fed up with how the state has handled allegations of fraud, going so far as to file lawsuits against state agencies. In June, the DOJ filed a **[lawsuit](https://substack.com/redirect/a6e32d0b-9ada-4e0d-8db6-3ae4f099cbfc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** against New York state officials for enabling fraud. The civil case alleges that New York's Department of Health and its state Medicaid Director are engaged in a backroom deal with Public Partnerships LLC, which has managed New York's Consumer Directed Personal Assistance Program (CDPAP), a $10 billion Medicaid program for disabled individuals. The DOJ has alleged that the state engaged in a fake bidding process when they had pre-selected Public Partnerships. The arrangement allegedly allowed the private company to generate "millions of dollars in unauthorized profits funded by federal taxpayers in connection with its takeover of New York's $10 billion-dollar CDPAP program."
Healthcare fraud is usually estimated to be around **[3-10%](https://substack.com/redirect/3ffbafee-6f77-448e-80f9-d754ed0d3ba2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** of program spending. For New York's $115 billion per year Medicaid system, this could account for as much as $11.5 billion per year, most of which goes unprosecuted. According to AG James, the state has only uncovered **[$627 million](https://substack.com/redirect/4edb89d9-6677-40d3-b017-c0dc6aa1cde7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in the six years between 2019-2025. This suggests that there could be as much as $10 billion in Medicaid fraud in New York state alone every year.
* * *
* * *

|
Peter,
Yesterday, a federal judge ruled that the Trump administration had compiled an illegal database including highly sensitive and private information on Americans like names, addresses, social security numbers, and other private "data-mined" information.
The judge ordered the Trump administration to immediately end and delete the database, citing a "major violation" of American's privacy rights, specifically violations of the Privacy Act, the Social Security Act, and the Administrative Procedure Act.
The database was being used by the Trump administration to purge voter rolls in several states ahead of the midterm elections.
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016j7HDMzFpvZFZrRhYbevFfJeWS8jpLoABqfugA6i5Nb4YTXJkrHl2UEuDdC1AOwvOEf_nCa-Z2qBx96ViI3UqduhM_nS4JCUUnm1W4zNKFgfqPhCjfuh4pctb1Lrc5WhHrTrCuKmXKYuVVsUEzs2Cv0hmaxNHRaRHAkNwUipvEYFS-BHC2CxhumjjaiMuO7Sie7wjLP5Cexs4smzBgLFfN9srYc3ynwM2kTp4LqRg8s=&c=IABAj2uj9NvmWvIv2Katqjb516vYP1TRRIdvOCNnZvk8Fu_8L91KBA==&ch=vjRryY1mMuOR6DPQEwp15_WSY5HTr02yebAJksXxEeFq48Snfrv8JA==)
---
The details of the database are spine chilling.
Compiling information from the Social Security administration, the Department of Homeland Security, and even mysterious "data-mined" information acquired from the shadowy private defense contractor Palantir, the Trump administration had created a searchable database of every American citizen. The data was then "compared" with voter registration data that the Trump administration has been quietly collecting from states, with at least 8 states confirmed to have given voter data to DHS as of this Spring.
The Trump admin claimed that this database was accurately identifying "fake or ineligible voters" and revoking their voter registration status ahead of the midterm elections. But it was revealed in court that Democratic voters were being wrongfully purged from the voter rolls instead. Who could have seen that coming?
This comes as the Trump admin and USPS just introduced a new rule that serves as a mafia-style shakedown on blue states still refusing to give the administration access to their voter data--hand over your data or USPS will not deliver mail-in ballots in your state:

And if you've been following our work at Defend Our Courts, you would know that they have several insidious schemes running in parallel at this very moment.
This time, the court stopped them in their tracks. And thankfully, the judge who issued the decision had a conscience not clouded by MAGA dark money or sympathies for Trump's fascist ambitions. But this won't always be the case, and there is still a chance this specific case gets appealed all the way up to the US Supreme Court, where the MAGA judges sitting on the bench have revealed themselves as nothing more than useful pawns in Trump's fascist pursuits.

Welcome to the July edition of **_The JanePAC Monthly_**. If last month proved anything, it's that our movement has momentum, and Big Oil is feeling it. Their money is no match for people who refuse to give up on a livable future. We've got wins to share, updates to unpack, and a lot of road still ahead. Let's dive in! 👇
* * *
**🌎 OUR PRIMARY MOMENTUM ROLLS ON IN COLORADO** Our JanePAC climate champions swept through the Colorado primary — _one of the nation's top energy-producing states_ — and they're taking that energy into November. **Jena Griswold** advanced in the race for Attorney General, bringing a climate and democracy champion closer to a seat with real power to hold polluters accountable. And in frontline communities surrounding the Suncor refinery — some of the most polluted ZIP codes in the nation — champions like **Justine Sandoval (House District 5), Chela Garcia Irlando (State Senate District 34), and Kenny Nguyen (House District 33)** beat back hundreds of thousands of dollars from a Big Oil-funded dark money group to advance to November. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134761527/632075163/2105508926?refcode=ea.844bd676-7679-f111-ac9c-000d3a14b6d6&ms=ea.844bd676-7679-f111-ac9c-000d3a14b6d6&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg0NGJkNjc2LTc2NzktZjExMS1hYzljLTAwMGQzYTE0YjZkNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=_AxM28MA-4zJyGFaRG9jVVI1Lbbp77QLwS3xzn_Phvk=) We also want to take a moment to honor **Julie Gonzales** — a fearless champion who ran a bold, heartfelt race for U.S. Senate. Despite being outspent almost 10-1, leaders like Julie remind us exactly why this fight matters. JanePAC will always go to bat for true climate champions, win or lose. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134761528/632075164/2105508926?refcode=ea.844bd676-7679-f111-ac9c-000d3a14b6d6&ms=ea.844bd676-7679-f111-ac9c-000d3a14b6d6&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg0NGJkNjc2LTc2NzktZjExMS1hYzljLTAwMGQzYTE0YjZkNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=_AxM28MA-4zJyGFaRG9jVVI1Lbbp77QLwS3xzn_Phvk=) Jane was there to witness the energy up close, and it was electric — packed rooms, fired-up volunteers, communities determined to fight for their own future. That's the heart of how we win: _not by outspending Big Oil, but by out-organizing them and centering people every day._ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/134761529/632075165/2105508926?refcode=ea.844bd676-7679-f111-ac9c-000d3a14b6d6&ms=ea.844bd676-7679-f111-ac9c-000d3a14b6d6&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg0NGJkNjc2LTc2NzktZjExMS1hYzljLTAwMGQzYTE0YjZkNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=_AxM28MA-4zJyGFaRG9jVVI1Lbbp77QLwS3xzn_Phvk=) Every one of these wins happened because supporters like you turned out. **⚖️ SUPREME COURT UPDATE**
We told you we'd keep you posted.
**Supreme Court backs Monsanto in its fight against liability from popular weed killer** _\- NPR, 6/25/26_
---
The Supreme Court has ruled in the Roundup case that hits close to home for Jane.
In a 7-2 decision, the Court sided with Monsanto — now owned by Bayer — shielding the company from liability claims that its weedkiller caused cancer. Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson dissented, warning the ruling leaves harmed people without a remedy.
The result could narrow the company's liability across **tens of thousands of pending cases.** It's another reminder of what's at stake when corporations are shielded from accountability, and why electing climate champions matters _now more than ever._

clean_body: We told you we'd keep you posted. | Welcome to the July edition of The JanePAC Monthly. If last month proved anything, it's that our movement has momentum, and Big Oil is feeling it. Their money is no match for people who refuse to give up on a livable future. We've got wins to share, updates to unpack, and a lot of road still ahead. Let's dive in! 👇 🌎 OUR PRIMARY MOMENTUM ROLLS ON IN COLORADO Our JanePAC climate champions swept through the Colorado primary — one of the nation's top energy-producing states — and they're taking that energy into November. Jena Griswold advanced in the race for Attorney General, bringing a climate and democracy champion closer to a seat with real power to hold polluters accountable. And in frontline communities surrounding the Suncor refinery — some of the most polluted ZIP codes in the nation — champions like Justine Sandoval (House District 5), Chela Garcia Irlando (State Senate District 34), and Kenny Nguyen (House District 33) beat back hundreds of thousands of dollars from a Big Oil-funded dark money group to advance to November. = We also want to take a moment to honor Julie Gonzales — a fearless champion who ran a bold, heartfelt race for U.S. Senate. Despite being outspent almost 10-1, leaders like Julie remind us exactly why this fight matters. JanePAC will always go to bat for true climate champions, win or lose. = Jane was there to witness the energy up close, and it was electric — packed rooms, fired-up volunteers, communities determined to fight for their own future. That's the heart of how we win: not by outspending Big Oil, but by out-organizing them and centering people every day. = Every one of these wins happened because supporters like you turned out. That's the story of our movement. And with more primaries ahead, we're just getting started. 🎟️ ICYMI: JOIN JANE FOR LEADERS WE DESERVE There's still time to secure your virtual spot to join Jane and David Hogg — activist, Parkland survivor, and founder of Leaders We Deserve — for The Fight For Our Future on Tuesday, July 14th at 4:30 PM PT / 7:30 PM ET. = = | = ⚖️ SUPREME COURT UPDATE We told you we'd keep you posted. Supreme Court backs Monsanto in its fight against liability from popular weed killer \- NPR, 6/25/26 The Supreme Court has ruled in the Roundup case that hits close to home for Jane. In a 7-2 decision, the Court sided with Monsanto — now owned by Bayer — shielding the company from liability claims that its weedkiller caused cancer. Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson dissented, warning the ruling leaves harmed people without a remedy. The result could narrow the company's liability across tens of thousands of pending cases. It's another reminder of what's at stake when corporations are shielded from accountability, and why electing climate champions matters now more than ever. 🌡️ A DANGEROUSLY HOT FOURTH Over the July Fourth weekend, a massive heat dome settled over more than half the country, pushing temperatures into dangerous territory for millions of Americans. It was a stark reminder that our summers are getting hotter and more punishing. Most of all, please take care of yourself and the people around you. Knowing what to do in a heat emergency can save a life. , covering everything from spotting the early signs of heat illness, to cooling your home when the power's stretched thin, to organizing your block so no one has to face the heat alone. That's it for this edition of The JanePAC Monthly. Thank you for being part of this movement. If you want to stay plugged in between newsletters, follow us on social media for daily updates and behind-the-scenes moments with Jane and the team: Together, we are building a movement they cannot ignore. And we're just getting started. In solidarity, – Team JanePAC Before you scroll away, our candidates are up against the oil and gas lobby and the billionaires backing it, all hellbent on protecting a political system that rewards their bottom line. The Jane Fonda Climate PAC exists to disrupt that status quo by unseating politicians in the pocket of corporate polluters and replacing them with climate champions willing to fight like hell for our planet and the communities we call home. = | = | = | = = Follow along: | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. name: Ilhan Omar
subject: A straightforward note about Israel
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
Americans are tired of seeing our tax dollars being used to commit war crimes.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2336%2E791427%2Ep7scH6)
Friend, I’m going to be straightforward here. I hope you’ll read on.
The US relationship with Israel has been front and center in elections across the country this year.
And what we’ve seen is candidates who call out the Gaza genocide and reject AIPAC winning from New York to Pennsylvania to Colorado. **This should surprise no one.**
For almost three years now, we have watched as the Israeli military has waged a brutal military campaign, killing tens of thousands of civilians, murdering innocent kids and babies, and displacing millions of people. War crimes have been committed on an almost daily basis, from the restriction of humanitarian aid to the intentional targeting of entire families. This, backdropped by almost 80 years of illegal occupation, ethnic cleansing, and apartheid.
And what has been the establishment's response to this historic injustice? To continue to stand by Israel’s actions. To continue to send Israel billions of dollars in military aid and weapons. And to tell people they had it all wrong — and even punish them — when they spoke up, protested, and pushed for change from a place of moral clarity.
It’s no wonder that that same establishment is now stunned that Americans are outraged, and losing ground fast.
**It’s been an uphill battle, but the movement for dignity, peace, and self-determination for Palestine is growing larger every day, and thanks to your tireless efforts, we are electing more pro-Palestine champions than at any time in American history.**
Americans are tired of seeing our tax dollars being used to commit war crimes. We are done with being told that we must support occupation and apartheid. And we are fed up with AIPAC and Israel’s allies in the US spending millions of dollars to defeat progressives and maintain the status quo.
[**Friend, I am a proud sponsor of the _Block the Bombs Act,_ which would restrict military aid to Israel. If you want to keep this movement pushing forward, add your name as a citizen co-sponsor of this legislation and help us keep turning up the pressure.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em_block_the_bombs_cosponsor_jul26/?source=em260706-1-180&refcode2=2336.791427.p7scH6&akid=2336%2E791427%2Ep7scH6)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/em_block_the_bombs_cosponsor_jul26/?source=em260706-1-180&refcode2=2336.791427.p7scH6&akid=2336%2E791427%2Ep7scH6)**
Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. famously said, "The arc of the moral universe is long, but it bends toward justice," and we are watching that happen in real time.
Palestinians have endured decades of injustice, but we are making progress towards an eventual peace for _everyone_ in the region. It starts with ending the US government’s unconditional support for Israel and redefining our approach around international law and universal human rights.
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

subject: They're in it for themselves. Full stop.
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
I want to ask you something, and I need you to chip in $5 or $10 to Equal Opportunity Now at this link [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email] before you finish reading this email — because what I'm about to tell you is exactly why this organization exists.
Here's the truth about Washington that nobody in power wants to say out loud:
The system is working exactly as designed. Just not for you.
And now, with Donald Trump and his MAGA allies in power, it has gotten worse. Dramatically worse.
Think about what we've watched happen in just the last eighteen months.
The Department of Justice — turned into a weapon against Trump's political enemies. The free press — attacked, delegitimized, and frozen out. Elections — undermined at every turn, with new laws designed not to protect the vote but to restrict it. Independent oversight — gutted. Inspectors general — fired in the middle of the night. And Members of Congress — too many of them — standing by and letting it happen for their own political self preservation.
This is not what democracy looks like. This is what the slow death of democracy looks like.
I've spent my career fighting this. I have led the fight to ban stock trading by Members of Congress because I believe that when you serve the public, you serve the public — not your portfolio. I believe in term limits because I believe that power was never meant to be permanent, and that fresh voices and fresh accountability are the only antidote to the rot that sets in when the same people hold the same seats for decades. I've fought for transparency, for oversight, for a government that actually answers to the people it represents.
But here's what I've learned: You cannot reform a system that is actively working to prevent reform. You have to change who's in the room.
That is what Equal Opportunity Now is built to do.
We are going to find leaders who come to this fight without the baggage of decades in power. Leaders who haven't been compromised, who haven't been bought, who haven't forgotten why they wanted to serve in the first place. Leaders who will walk in the door on day one and fight for term limits, for ethics reform, for a government that works for the people — not the powerful.
Because here's the thing about democracy: It doesn't defend itself. It requires people who are willing to fight for it. Every single day. Against forces that are better funded, better organized, and more ruthless than anything we've faced before.
Will you chip in $5 or $10 to Equal Opportunity Now today to help us elect the leaders who will fight to restore honest, accountable government to this country? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email] [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]

Democracy doesn't defend itself.
Let's defend it, together.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi
Founder | Equal Opportunity Now

---
Hi friend, it's Deb Haaland. We made history by winning all 33 counties across New Mexico in the Democratic primary, officially securing the Democratic nomination for Governor. I couldn't be more proud of the work we've accomplished, or more excited about the fight ahead.
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/13167?refcode=jtk988-fr-nd&t=2&akid=10849%2E400544%2ELDwx7g)
---
This moment wouldn't be possible without the strong women who raised me and the values they passed down: work hard, care for your community, and always make room for others at the table. Growing up, I watched my grandmother bake bread in her mud oven and stir huge pots of posole. She taught me that food brings people together, and cooking became one of my favorite ways to connect with family, culture, and community.

One of my _favorite_ New Mexican staples to make is green chile salsa. The taste of fresh tomatoes and local green chile always brings me back home — to my family, our traditions, and the values that shaped me.

I love this recipe so much, in fact, it inspired me to start my very own salsa company to support my family. From finding capital to get started, to overseeing the work in the commercial kitchen, to delivering jars of salsa to mom and pop shops in Los Lunas, Belen, Bernalillo, and more — I was a part of every step, knowing I was supporting my child, contributing to our local economy, and bringing Pueblo culture into grocery stores across the state.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/13167?refcode=jtk988-fr-nd&t=3&akid=10849%2E400544%2ELDwx7g)
Food brings communities and people together, friend. When we share a home-cooked meal or baked goods, we share our traditions, our stories, and the care and time it takes to nourish our families. During this campaign, I've traveled across the state, meeting New Mexican families from all walks of life, breaking bread, and sharing my vision for New Mexico.

I've shared my own struggles and listened to theirs. Together, we’ve made exciting plans for the future of New Mexico. I know New Mexicans want a Governor who will fight for affordable healthcare, expand child care, make our communities safer, strengthen our schools, and protect our environment.
**That’s the kind of Governor I will be.**
**I am ready on day one to get to work and deliver progress for our communities, including making it easier for local neighborhood markets to open and for grocery stores to carry home-grown food, especially to eliminate food deserts across New Mexico.**
[**_Pl_** _**ease, if you believe in my vision for a brighter New Mexico, chip in $5 or whatever you can spare now to help me become the next Governor. When you click this link and donate, I'll share my own green chile salsa recipe with you! >>**_](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/13168?refcode=jtk988-fr-nd&t=4&akid=10849%2E400544%2ELDwx7g)

Deb

I love this recipe so much, in fact, it inspired me to start my very own salsa company to support my family. From finding capital to get started, to overseeing the work in the commercial kitchen, to delivering jars of salsa to mom and pop shops in Los Lunas, Belen, Bernalillo, and more — I was a part of every step, knowing I was supporting my child, contributing to our local economy, and bringing Pueblo culture into grocery stores across the state. Food brings communities and people together, friend. When we share a home-cooked meal or baked goods, we share our traditions, our stories, and the care and time it takes to nourish our families. During this campaign, I've traveled across the state, meeting New Mexican families from all walks of life, breaking bread, and sharing my vision for New Mexico. I've shared my own struggles and listened to theirs. Together, we’ve made exciting plans for the future of New Mexico. I know New Mexicans want a Governor who will fight for affordable healthcare, expand child care, make our communities safer, strengthen our schools, and protect our environment. That’s the kind of Governor I will be. I am ready on day one to get to work and deliver progress for our communities, including making it easier for local neighborhood markets to open and for grocery stores to carry home-grown food, especially to eliminate food deserts across New Mexico. | | Thank you for your support, Deb | | | | |

**TOP NEWS**
**" Comptroller candidate Don Huffines appointed to role ahead of November election"** via [KXAN](https://substack.com/redirect/b83ea9be-0950-47fc-800a-f357f842bcf6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)'s **Adam Schwager** - AUSTIN (Nexstar) -- Republican nominee for Comptroller **Don Huffines** is now the incumbent heading into November's election. On Thursday, Republican Gov.**Greg Abbott** appointed Huffines to replace acting Comptroller **Kelly Hancock** , who resigned from the position. Huffines' appointment is effective on Aug. 1. In March, Huffines shattered Hancock's hopes of winning the role permanently, handing him a resounding defeat in the Republican primary. Now, he'll take over the job earlier than anticipated.

"Don Huffines brings the right mix of business experience and conservative principles to this vital office," said Abbott in a statement. "He is a fifth-generation Texan, successful businessman, and proven conservative leader who puts taxpayers first. His private-sector experience and dedication to limited government make him exceptionally qualified to lead the state's finances and protect every taxpayer dollar with integrity and accountability."

"I'm honored by the trust Governor Abbott has placed in me," said Huffines in the same release. "My commitment is simple: run government lean, protect every tax dollar, and keep Texas the best place to live, raise a family, and run a business."

In November, Huffines is facing State Sen. **Sarah Eckhardt** , D-Austin, to determine who will control the state's finances for the next four years. "Texans are struggling right now, and they need someone who will ask hard questions about where their money is going," Eckhardt said in a statement to Nexstar. "It's unlikely that another Abbott appointee is going to do that, but I've been doing it for 20 years as a public servant--I'm ready to give Texans the answers they're looking for as the independently elected Comptroller in November." _([KXAN](https://substack.com/redirect/b83ea9be-0950-47fc-800a-f357f842bcf6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))_
